name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Onboarding Manager | Team Leadership & High-Volume SMB Onboarding at Scale
summary: Onboarding leader with 15+ years in B2B SaaS, including 2 years directly managing and developing a team of onboarding specialists at Wix (a team of 20, later 8), personally onboarding 25+ SMB clients per month while holding 120% of sales and 110% of implementation targets. Builds the CRM data-hygiene standards and reporting infrastructure a high-volume onboarding team runs on, at Solenzo today. Comfortable holding a team accountable to velocity and quality standards while coaching them to a consistent, well-executed onboarding experience.

experience.title: Founder & Strategic / Marketing Operations Lead
bullets: Architect and implement complex CRM systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and strict data-hygiene protocols, the operational backbone a high-volume onboarding team runs on.
Identify strategic opportunities to expand retainer scope, tracking usage and engagement data to flag at-risk accounts early and build a recovery plan.

Architected and deployed a complete GoHighLevel automation system, 20+ workflows spanning lead capture, qualification, booking, and post-sale onboarding nurture, eliminating manual backlog drag in the process.
Document every client interaction, timeline, and deliverable across GoHighLevel, HubSpot, and Notion, maintaining data hygiene and reporting integrity across concurrent engagements.

experience.title: Account Executive / Client Strategist
bullets: Coordinated execution across internal departments as strategic lead, translating client goals into aligned delivery plans across teams.

experience.title: Channel Partnerships & Customer Onboarding
bullets: Onboarded and managed 15-20 reseller partners (deals ~$10K-$45K, spanning health, home services, and retail), retaining all but one (~94% retention) during tenure.
Analyzed partner utilization and performance metrics to identify adoption gaps and root causes, recommending interventions that reduced churn.
Advised partners on retention strategy and customer health metrics, escalating at-risk accounts with a defined path back on track.
Collaborated with Product and Engineering to translate structured partner feedback into roadmap input.

experience.title: Account Executive / Sales Operations
bullets: Took on team lead responsibilities for the sales team alongside individual account work, building internal processes that improved reporting accuracy and reduced handoff errors.

experience.title: Account Manager, Onboarding Launch Specialist & Team Lead
bullets: Directly managed and developed a team of onboarding specialists for 2 years (a team of 20, later a team of 8), running structured coaching and performance development across a high-value client portfolio.
Onboarded and launched 25+ clients per month personally, holding 120% of sales targets and 110% of implementation targets, while the team delivered at the same standard at scale.
Labeled and defined the CRM fields required for outbound sales and onboarding workflows, standardizing data capture and reporting integrity across the team.

Drove team initiatives and process improvements for a brand-new Wix vertical that went from proof of concept to a profitable business line, contributing to hiring, onboarding, and training of new hires and developing sales training for tenured account executives.
Managed a high-value account portfolio, contributing to a 30% increase in website traffic and 25% improvement in conversion rates across the e-commerce segment.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Ranked top three in sales on a team of 8 to 15 reps while quota roughly doubled, sustaining performance under rising targets.
Built sequenced implementation plans for incoming clients, ranking which systems to change and in what order, then handed off to the implementation team to execute.
